message.content: The highest‑grossing film worldwide (as of 2026) is **“Avatar” (2009)**, directed by James Cameron. It has earned roughly **$2.92 billion** at the global box office, surpassing all other movies—including the massive “Avengers: Endgame” ($2.80 billion) and “Titanic” ($2.20 billion). The record includes revenue from the original 2009 release, the 2010 re‑release, and the 2022 3D/4K re‑release, which pushed the total past the $2.9 billion mark.
